name: hw-pipeline
title: Hand-Drawn Flowchart
description: Wobbled boxes with handwritten labels joined by curved connectors, drawing on in sequence from a list of steps.
useWhen: A process or pipeline of 2 to 6 steps should draw itself on screen like a quick whiteboard sketch.
The look should be hand-made and a little imperfect.
avoidWhen: You need data-heavy diagrams with precise geometry: use a data-viz block.
More than 6 steps or long labels.
author: HeyGen (Hyperframes)

variables.label: Steps
variables.description: Box labels in order, comma separated (1 to 6).

variables.label: Label size
variables.description: Label size in design pixels (shrinks when many boxes).

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the drawing sits over your own scene.

variables.label: Boil
variables.description: Lines jitter slightly every third frame, like hand-redrawn animation.

variables.label: Seed
variables.description: Changes the wobble of the hand-drawn lines.
